subject: Post-call: SOC 2 evidence & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>, Acme Security Team <secops@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: SOC 2 evidence & next steps

Hi Jordan / Acme Security team,

Thanks again for taking the time today — good conversation and appreciate you walking us through the audit objectives. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so nothing falls through the cracks: 

Summary / pain points you raised:
- You need a SOC 2 Type II report covering the last 12 months (explicitly including changes to access controls post-Jan 2025).
- Retention and accessible audit logs for up to 1 year (with the ability to extend to longer-term archival for regulatory needs).
- DPA with specific subprocessor notices and the ability to include stricter data residency clauses.
- Pen test evidence / summary report and remediation timeline.

What Redwood can provide (high level):
- SOC 2 Type II report (we have a completed report for the 2025 assessment).
- Audit log export (per org) and configurable retention policies — default 90 days but extendable via Dedicated/Private options.
- Draft DPA that includes subprocessor list and standard EU data clauses (we can add custom residency language for enterprise contracts).
- Pen test summary and redlines; we can provide the full remediation timeline and CVE mapping where applicable.

Agreed next steps:
1) I will share the SOC 2 Type II report, pen test summary, and our DPA draft (attached).
2) Schedule a technical deep-dive with Dev to confirm log formats, retention mechanics, and export tooling (Dev, can you please propose 2x times?).
3) We'll produce a mutual action plan (MAP) and a draft statement of work + pricing for Dedicated capacity if you choose extended retention/archival.

Attachments I will send in a follow-up: SOC2 report, pen test summary, DPA draft, and a readiness checklist.

If that captures everything, I'll send the attachments and the DocuSign link for the DPA draft and coordinate a technical session.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 evidence & next steps

Thanks Marissa — that matches my notes. A few quick asks so we can route this internally: 

1) Can you attach the full SOC 2 Type II report (not just the summary) and the pen test report (redacted if needed)? We need both for our procurement and InfoSec review.
2) For retention: is the retention configurable per-organization, or do we need Dedicated/Private to get >90 days? What's the expected cost impact for 1 year vs 90 days?
3) Who should our procurement team talk to for PO/contract terms?

If you can drop the docs and a DocuSign link for the DPA draft, procurement can start the paperwork in parallel to the technical deep-dive.

Regards,

Jordan Lee
Security Manager | Acme Corp
jordan.lee@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>, Acme Security Team <secops@acme.com>

Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 evidence & next steps

Jordan — thanks. See attached items and inline answers below.

Attachments included:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (pdf, 2.1MB)
- PenTest_Summary_2025.pdf (pdf, 350KB) — redacted as discussed; full technical appendix available under NDA.
- Redwood_DPA_Draft.docx (docx, 95KB) — DocuSign link included below.

Inline answers:
- SOC 2 report: attached full Type II report (scheduled audit period: Apr 2024–Mar 2025). If you need the auditor contact for verification, we can include that.
- Pen test: attached summary; full report available under an NDA or we can provide a redacted technical appendix now.
- Retention: retention is configurable at the org level. Default on hosted is 90 days; you can extend to 1 year with a Dedicated retention pack or export to your S3 bucket for long-term archival. I'll include estimated pricing in the MAP.
- Procurement/PO: copy in Rishi (cc) — he will be the primary contact for commercial/terms and can coordinate the PO and any custom contract language.

Next steps I propose:
- Rishi to start procurement thread and share PO contact details.
- Dev to run a 60-minute technical deep-dive (log schema, API for exports, retention policy changes) — Dev, can you propose slots tomorrow and Thursday morning?
- I'll open a HubSpot MAP and attach the proposal + pricing for the Dedicated retention pack.

DocuSign (DPA draft): https://www.docusign.com/sign/abcdef-Redwood-DPA
HubSpot MAP / deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/6453/ACME-0426-1

Let me know if you need anything else — attaching the files now.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 evidence & next steps

Jordan / team — quick technical notes and proposed times: 

- Log format: we can export as JSONL or Parquet. Exports include timestamp, request_id, user_id (pseudonymized on request), operation, model_version, and raw tokens if requested under a Data Processing Agreement.
- Retention mechanics: org-level toggle to 90/180/365 days for online retention. For multi-year retention, we recommend S3 export + lifecycle rules.

Proposed technical deep-dive slots (PST):
- Tue, Mar 17 at 10:00 AM - 11:00 AM
- Thu, Mar 19 at 09:00 AM - 10:00 AM

I can present export samples and walk through the API during the session. If you prefer, we'll do an internal pre-call to line up specific endpoints.

Cheers,

Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0166
